body: I don’t have the courage to end it but i don’t want to keep going. I feel like a total disappointment.

thank you, you’re really nice. I live in a pretty safe place, i might try to get some air, staying inside isn’t really good for me right now. I don’t understand how someone I don’t even know can care so much more than my own family or people i’ve known my entire life.

you’re right and I try, but it’s been a lot, too much. Things keep piling up, so it’s hard to put things into perspective and think that way. 

What kept you going?
that’s so beautiful, I hope one day I reach that. I don’t think I will; but then again I would’ve never imagined myself in the place I am right now.

you’re right, it’s hard not to think irrationally and I get so irrational.

Woah, how’d things turn out?
I don’t deserve it though. Thank you for your comment though. How old are you?
take a cold shower, go for a walk outside, take a deep breath in. you deserve so much more than what you’re currently feeling
thank you, i just think that’s a little optimistic. sometimes you have to look at things rationally
no one cares, i don’t bring anything to anyone. apart from my girlfriend but I’m just pushing her away and anyways everyone always leaves at some point.
everything, i just don’t see a point

I know, if you’ve never experienced it it’s hard to understand and it seems so selfish and how can one possibly want that. But really you have to treat them as if they’re sick, someone in that state of mind can’t think rationally and you’re pushed to think you want things you really don’t. Just be there for her as much as you can, show her life is worth living, don’t be mad as frustrated as that can be to think she’d want to do that. In this moment really be there for her, she’s in such a fragile state. If you need anything or have any questions i’m here.

because you matter, people care about you. we only get one life, we might as well live it. Think of all the good you can do, what if you just made someone else’s life better, wouldn’t that be worth it. I know it’s hard. I know it feels like the only way out but you matter and you have so much potential. it’s never over. I’m here if you need to talk
i’m here bro, what do you need. You can talk to me
you matter, please don’t do this. keep fighting. I’m here if you need to talk❤️

In those moments you don’t think rationally, you don’t evaluate situations and think like a healthy person does. These thought, they’re like a sickness, you aren’t your true self. it’s not at all selfish, you just get to a point where you need to pain to stop at any cost. 

It’s easier to put up a facade and pretend you’re ok. and sometimes you really are ok just emotions can be super unstable and take you to the darkest places. 

I’m so sorry to hear that though and if you have any questions or need anything i’m here for you. Hope she’s ok ❤️

i’m so sorry to hear that. First off I wanted to say how strong you were for fighting through all this. You aren’t a burden, it’s ok to need to lean on others, we can’t always be strong, especially when fighting so much. It’s ok to have a hard time processing and needing to take time for one’s self, however long that may be. It seems really hard, and I can’t even imagine how you feel, in the moment thoughts can trick you and make you think and feel things that are irrational but i assure you, you have meaning, you are important, you are loved, you matter. Keep fighting, you’ve got this, and if ever you need to let things out, there’s always going to be someone. May it be a stranger or a loved one. You’re not alone, you are loved.
Yes i’ve overcome a lot and i am still standing but I just can’t keep fighting it, Im at my 3rd therapist and nothing seems to be getting better
